WHAT REMAINED: SHIPPING + THE SFN INTERFACE | G3-G6
Capabilities survive a change in who fulfills orders
|
+-- Shopify Shipping: self-shippers and negotiated rates
|   [S] Scale helps negotiate rates for smaller merchants.
|   [S] Eligible-merchant adoption: <40% Q4 2018; 45% Q4 2019.
|   [S] Q4 2020: 52%; Q1 2021: over half in the U.S. and Canada.
|   [I] No later adoption percentage is supplied here.
|   [S] End-2022 availability: seven countries.
|   [R] FY2025 shipping-label revenue accounted for on a net basis.
|
+-- SFN app: orchestration after the sale
|   [S] 2023: merchant-facing app retained, powered by Flexport.
|   [S] Q1 2025: expanded 3PL network; local warehouses and returns.
|   [S] Q3 2025: Amazon MCF, Big Blue, DHL, GoBolt and Maple.
|   [I] Integration preserves merchant access while partners execute.
|
+-- Cross-border capability in 2025
|   [S] Duty-paid labels available directly through Shopify.
|   [S] More carriers: Australia Post, Royal Mail, DHL Express Canada.
|   [S] DHL and Canada Post DDP options let duties be collected at checkout.
|   [S] Management says this can reduce customs-related friction.
|   Integrations -[D:claim]-> better cross-border experience.
|
Evidence: S1-S4. DDP = Delivered Duty Paid; 3PL = third-party logistics.
Tags: [R] filing/calculation; [S] management statement; [I] inference;
      [X] contradicted claim. Grades never imply causality:
      mech=definition/arithmetic; data=stated metric; claim=assertion;
      assoc=co-movement; untestable=missing evidence; contra=contradiction.
Edges: M=detail/structure; C=sequence; D=dependency. No causal grade used.
